title: Recover auth-mail runtime from the already-running canonical REG.RU Web container
acceptance: use only the single active REG.RU Compose Web container as the credential source
inspect only allowlisted current or legacy SMTP environment keys and never output their values
accept only sm38.hosting.reg.ru port 465 and access@процент-агро.рф in Unicode or canonical ASCII IDN form
perform SMTP authentication only and send no message during the credential proof
perform no file mutation when no complete canonical SMTP environment exists or SMTP authentication fails
require pinned production DNS and SSH host identity before server inspection
reuse scripts/provision-production-p0-password-reset-runtime.sh for root-only delivery and transactional-mail runtime creation
publish only bounded source/result/blocker markers and never credential values, raw environment or protected paths
perform no database or deployment mutation
